answer: Each voting identity must lock a scarce, slashed stake of native tokens at a public jetty contract tied to one key, then pass a live proof-of-possession ping every epoch. Verifiers check the locked amount, the 30-day unbond delay, and the ping signature; a miss or reused lock burns the stake to an ember and evicts that identity. Because the lock cannot be shared, an attacker pays the full stake plus lock-time cost for every fake ID, and only paid-up keys can reach the zenith of committee weight.
